title: Refusing the Suzaku Legacy
summary: Inside the crystal, an image of Ye Wuyou, the first Suzaku, tells Wang Lin that the crystal picks its own master when someone tries to destroy it, and that it has chosen him. Wang Lin turns down the title, saying his path will not stop at one planet, and Ye Wuyou tells him a life soul can be won by killing its spirit creature or by trading one life for another. Outside, the cultivators fight over the ownerless crystal, and Zhu Quezi appears through a bronze figure of outer-world iron that he gave Qian Feng, meaning to seize his own disciple's body and lifespan. Wang Lin goes after Qian Feng for himself and for Hongdie, and Qian Feng draws the Ancient God Blood Sword, an heirloom of the Qian family carrying Nine-Star Ancient God blood. Tuo Sen then descends in his true avatar, a monkey, strengthened by that drop of blood. Wang Lin kills Qian Feng and uses his life to win back the life souls, while Zi Xin takes Qian Feng's cultivation through a reversal technique Yun Quezi taught her. Tuo Sen corners Wang Lin, who blows up the souls in his Soul Flag and hides in the Heaven Defying Bead, until a Cultivation Alliance envoy seals Tuo Sen, pardons Zhu Quezi, and greets Wang Lin as an old acquaintance.
events: Ye Wuyou's image offers Wang Lin the Suzaku title and he refuses

Wang Lin self-destructs the Soul Flag's souls and hides in the Heaven Defying Bead
A Cultivation Alliance envoy seals Tuo Sen and pardons Zhu Quezi
cultivation: Qian Feng is at Soul Transformation; Zi Xin gains his cultivation. Wang Lin reached Foundation Establishment when he first obtained the Ancient God memory inheritance.
